column1: # Glucosinolate-biosynthesis chemistry curation
# Source: Generate_Core_ModelTemplate.py lines 527-563 (hard-coded; lifted here)
# Three change blocks:
#   3) BCAT3 transaminase generic compounds replaced with specific 2-oxoglutarate / glutamate
#   4) Monooxygenase generic hemoproteins replaced with flavins (FAD/FADH2 pair)
#   5) Methylthioalkylmalate dehydrogenase (IMDH) NAD usage: add NAD+/NADH pair,
#      remove the H+ that the base reaction carried for charge balance.
# Schema:  enzyme \t action \t field \t value \t [extra_1] \t [extra_2]
# Actions used here:
#   ASSIGN direction <dir>             - sets the reaction direction (existing)
#   UPDATE stoichiometry cpd coeff     - upserts coefficient; 0 to remove (existing)
#   ADD    reagent cpd coeff [cpt]     - PROPOSED: append a brand-new reagent
#   REPLACE compound  old_cpd new_cpd  - PROPOSED: substitute one compound for
#                                        another wherever it appears in the
#                                        reaction (preserves coefficients + compartments)
# ---- Block 3: BCAT3 transaminases (rxn23780, rxn27069-73) — swap two generics
# These changes apply to every base reaction the role catalyses, so one row per
# (compound replacement) is enough; the apply pipeline iterates the role's
# reactions and substitutes in each.
2-oxo-5-methylthiopentanoate transaminase (EC 2.6.1.-)
2-oxo-5-methylthiopentanoate transaminase (EC 2.6.1.-)
